records.premises: Registered valid map changes; map save throws an ordinary locally rescued error before changing old disk data; tileset/system save and subsequent processing/output succeed; no overrides/concurrent mutation.
records.ordinary_control: All writes succeed: changed map/tilesets/system saved; modified-and-saved warning requested. Unchanged map does not request saves or map warning.
records.minimal_counterexample: Given map save raises EACCES before mutation, saveMap returns nil; driver still saves tilesets/system and records modified-and-saved text. Disk map retains old bytes while memory map changed and warning is requested.
records.failure_partial_commit: Map save itself may also fail after truncation/partial write under different explicit I/O premise. Local rescue does not roll back map memory or later independent saves; tileset/system failure aborts before record append, so warning not guaranteed in that distinct case.
records.correct_existing_scope: WP75:295 explicitly describes swallowed map-save exception/nil/no report; WP75:414/444 repeat it. Therefore no new behavior gap established. WP04:200 can be read as save request summary; clarify/link only if independent full owner finds a real inconsistency.
records.negative_evidence: Full Compiler004 and fullWP04 read; only WP75 ranges290–299/410–415/438–445 personally continuous read, not whole primary. rg locators do not give WP75 full credit.
records.minimal_revision_if_root_requires: Only qualify WP04 save as request/possible local failure and point to correctWP75; preserve successful normal case, changed-only gates, map/common separation.
records.acceptance: Three explicit controls: success; unchanged; changed+map-save failure+later saves success. Assert memory/disk/output separately. NOT_EXECUTED.
